title: Is long-term unemployment a real issue in the EU?
subtitle: In 2025, an average of 1.8% of the EU labour force was affected by long-term unemployment. This represents a fall of 42% compared with 2018 (3.1%).
textNote: The long-term unemployment rate is the percentage of the working population aged between 15 and 74 who have been unemployed for 12 months or more.
